en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate neo‑Baroque building with many large arched windows, sculptural decorations, and domed roof pavilions. In front of the building is a busy outdoor café terrace with wrought‑iron railings, sun umbrellas, and people walking or seated at tables. A striped canopy extends along the right side. Text at the bottom left reads "Weltbad Karlsbad. Café Pupp," and a sign on the building reads "CAFÉ PUPP." Behind the building is a wooded hillside.
